description: MNT GRID Nord-Pas de Calais 2012-2013 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géo2France. Digital terrain model (DTM) produced from stereoscopic aerial photographs at 20 cm spatial resolution of the 2012-2013 PPIGE orthophotography. It is in the form of a seedling of points at steps of 10 and 20 meters covering the entire North Region - Pas de Calais. Coverage: Géo2France. The publisher named on the listing is Géo2France. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, mnt, 2013, 2012, modele-numerique-de-terrain, nord-pas-de-calais. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
